summary: # Avatar Accessory Registration | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive ## Introduction Hey everyone, my name is Phoebe, and I'm going to go through an update we have with registering shoes. So let's jump on in and have some fun while we learn. ## Registering Accessories As you may know, sometimes you want to use third-party assets or other things to see your shoes. Additionally, we have our entire Connect assets for you to look for shoes and find them. If you have created some or you're using another OBJ or anything like that, this is how you can register them all in Clo as shoes. ## Registering Shoes in Clo In the Avatar section, I can go to register accessories and pick any of these accessories. They can be created anywhere, but I'm going to go with shoes. For this demonstration, I will select heels. 1. **Selecting Shoes**: I can then hit open and find the heels that I'm going to pick. 2. **Identifying Shoe Orientation**: If you have a right or left shoe, you can specify this by using the underscore followed by a lowercase 'r' or 'l' for right or left shoe, respectively. If you have both, you can bring them in together, and Clo will recognize which one is right and which one is left. It's smart enough to figure it out now. ## Setting Heel Status Now that I have my shoes here, I can indicate the heel status. Since I selected heels, I can simply right-click and set the status to heel. - **Mistakes**: If I accidentally click the wrong place for heels, I can right-click and unset it easily. If set correctly, it will highlight red, making it super easy to identify. ## Saving and Moving Shoes Once I have my heels registered, I can hit save, and my heels will be stored in my folder. I can open this folder and drag and drop these shoes into my workspace. ### Moving the Avatar Because I’ve set this as heels, I can select my avatar and right-click to move the avatar and garments to the ground. It looks great and is really simple to do. ## Conclusion Have fun registering as many shoes as you want! Thanks so much for watching. If you have any questions, please use the comment section down below. Don't forget to like and subscribe! There's a ton of videos on our channel that will help you out with many things in Clo, so please check them out and keep having fun creating in Clo. Thanks again!
